title: Xpro India Ltd. (NSE: XPROINDIA) — Company Dossier
sector: Industrials / Specialty Polymer Films (capacitor-grade dielectric film, coextruded sheets)
archetype: Project-stage specialty-materials small cap (capacity expansion ahead of earnings)
primer: REJECTED on price, not on the business. Xpro India is a survivor with clean accounts, an A-/A1 rating and a real capacitor-film franchise, rated CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL in Pass 1 [8]. At the 12 November 2026 close of ₹1,142.20 the shares trade at 76.0x trailing earnings, and our probability-weighted value of ₹865 is 24.3% below the close. Even a pullback to technical support leaves the ₹811 base case below the entry, so the 1.5:1 gate fails and ₹620-660 is a re-underwriting zone, not an order. XPROINDIA is not in the positions ledger, so the holding action is NOT_HELD and new cash stays in cash.
holding_rationale: The same-session positions ledger lists 18 Zerodha positions, and XPROINDIA is not one of them. There is no holding to keep, trim or exit and no stop to ratchet. No purchase is recommended. The base-case value of ₹811 sits below the whole technical support zone. The probability-weighted value of ₹865 is 24.3% below the 12 November close. If shares are held in an account outside this ledger, treat a daily close below ₹1,105 as the first review line. Treat the ₹960-940 zone as the second. These are advisory alerts, not broker orders.

holding_alerts.instruction: Treat the retest as failed; next downside shelf is ₹960-940, then ₹913.8 and the ₹813.0 March 2026 closing low. No shares are held, so nothing is sold.
Re-run the full underwriting with a fresh same-session snapshot; at ₹660 the base case offers 1.51:1 against a ₹560 stop.

holding_alerts.trigger: Q3 FY2027 results and UAE dry-run update (February 2027)
holding_alerts.instruction: Check Barjora Line 2 utilisation against the 70-80% target, the UAE schedule, any disclosed dielectric margin and cash conversion.

holding_alerts.instruction: Recompute central-case PAT: capitalisation of about ₹358 Cr starts depreciation and interest; re-underwrite only if utilisation and margin evidence also improve.

destinations.entry_condition: Fund an outside name only after a separate evidence-backed company review clears the same hurdles.

destinations.recommendation: Retain the entire next marginal unit in cash.
destinations.rationale: The only equity under review fails the valuation gate (weighted value 24.3% below the close) and its tape is a thin-volume retest below a flat 30-week average; cash preserves optionality until a setup clears evidence and entry hurdles.
destinations.entry_condition: Reallocate when Xpro India enters ₹620-660, or when another equity candidate clears current evidence, valuation and technical gates.

horizons.rationale: A thin-volume bounce into the flat 30-week, 50-day and 200-day cluster at ₹1,120-1,195; not in Stage 2; reward to nearest resistance is only 1.4:1 against a ₹1,105 stop.
Barjora Line 2 ramp, UAE commercial start and first margin disclosure are checkable within six months, but the price has already moved 14.6% to pay for them.
A 13,000 t platform could compound only if ROIC clears 12%; the central case reaches about 8.8% and Indian capacity already exceeds demand.

gate_exceptions: Session cutoff and data basis. The Nifty 50 benchmark's last verified bar was 12 November 2026 when the ledger was built. Two attempts to build the 13 November session returned a stale-data stop, so the dossier is dated 12 November per the run protocol. XPROINDIA was added to the dated market-facts ledger, which supplies the verified close of ₹1,142.20 and the moving averages [4]. The TradingView snapshot and the compiled peer table were pulled at 17:29 PST on 13 November and carry a later print (₹1,190.10, +4.19%, 0.6x average volume). Decision levels are anchored to the 12 November ledger, and the verdict was re-tested against the later print, where it does not change [10].

Segment and product-level economics are not audited. Xpro reports one operating segment, so the dielectric versus Coex margin split is inferred from management ranges and audited totals (our calculation). The implied dielectric margin of 16-23% against 35-55% quoted is an estimate that management has not confirmed [2].

Deterministic table labels. The compiler's technical-ledger tables mix fields from the dated 12 November ledger (close, 20/50/200-day averages, RSI, 1-day change) with fields from the 13 November TradingView snapshot (30-week and 10-week averages, extension percentages, volume ratio, rating, support band and the tool's invalidation level). They also carry two heuristic labels that are not our valuation: the screener's 'Reasonable / In-line' and TradingView's 'Strong Buy (+0.54)'. The sizing table labels the three scenario values as 12-month values, and the redeployment text says 'every dollar' where it means every rupee. Chapter 9 dates the scenario values to 31 March 2028 on FY2029E earnings. Chapter 8's own tables state the basis of every figure. Treat the compiler tables as the snapshot reference and Chapters 7 to 9 as the decision basis [10][4].

Peer and stage inputs. The peer table (Chapter 7) and the TradingView stage label use the 13 November scanner print. The TheWrap Stage 2 dashboard data is dated 8 November 2026, and XPROINDIA is not in its Stage 2 universe at that date [112]. No bulk or block-deal, delivery-percentage or FII/DII flow data was retrieved for XPROINDIA. The institutional-flow reading in Chapter 8 therefore rests on the quarterly shareholding pattern and volume only.

Research-record as-of ages. The citation check ran with the stale-as-of allowance, and each excepted figure is listed here with its age on the 12 November 2026 cutoff and what would cure it. Audited FY2026 revenue, EBITDA, PAT, cash flow, capex, FX loss, dielectric sales, customer share, share count, promoter holding and capacity target are dated 31 March 2026 (226 days). The cure is the FY2027 annual report, due mid-2027, and the December 2026 shareholding pattern for promoter holding. The Barjora Line 2 capitalisation of ₹212.34 Cr is dated 27 March 2026 (230 days), with the same cure. The Ind-Ra rating is dated 14 January 2026 (302 days), and its cure is the next annual review. The 22 May 2026 modal film price of ₹550 or more per kg is 174 days old. It is not on a clearly identical basis with the newer 4 November 2026 figure of ₹470-480, which is also in the record. The QIP terms are dated 29 February 2024 (987 days) and are a historical event with no cure. The newest operating evidence is the Q2 and H1 FY2027 results, call and presentation of 3 to 4 November 2026 and the 13 November 2026 postal ballot notice; no newer annual filing exists.

Reviewer models and rounds. The independent reviewer and the adversarial red team both ran on the agent runner's default model (the same model family as the configured reviewer); the configured red-team alias ao-foundry-lc/gpt-6.1-sol was not used. Round 1 returned REVISE from both passes (six judgment or mechanical REVISE findings and a bear case that held). Round 2 was a delta review and returned APPROVE from both. After round 2 two NOTE-level wording edits were made without a third review: a clearer pronoun in Chapter 5 and the description of the 22 May 2026 modal price in these notes. The remaining NOTEs are disclosed here and unchanged: the Chapter 7 case-table header on March 2029, the compiler's '12-month' label, and the report's statement that every start-up date set so far has slipped, which holds for the commissioning dates in the Chapter 5 audit and is untested for the UAE line's new date.
